Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show these required points: knowledge of the general principles of Data Warehousing and Data Lakes, hands-on experience with SQL, knowledge of Python, and experience with GCP or another cloud provider.

Kind regards
